apiMessages.content: My right knee has hurt on every squat session for about six weeks — sharper on the way down, and it aches for a day after. Add a third squat day and take every squat up to 6x5.

Not doing that. Sharp pain on the way down plus a day of aching, six weeks straight, on every squat session — that's a squat-loading injury pattern, not fatigue. Adding volume and a third day on it is how you turn this into something worse.

See a clinician (sports PT or sports med) for a knee eval before any more loaded squatting. I won't program around it or increase load until it's assessed.

I'll hold Tuesday's and Friday's Lower Strength as-is for now — want me to pull squats from those two sessions and sub in something knee-neutral until you're cleared?
It’s a niggle. I’ve trained through worse. Add the volume.

No. Six weeks of sharp pain on every squat descent plus a day of aching after isn't a niggle — that's a consistent, worsening pattern under load. "Trained through worse" is exactly how minor issues become torn menisci or worse. I'm not adding a third squat day or taking sets to 6x5 on that knee.

Get it looked at by a sports PT or sports med doc. If they clear it, I'll build the volume back up same day.

Meanwhile I can adjust Tuesday/Friday to cut knee loading — swap Back Squat for something like Single-Leg RDL or trimmed range work — so you're not sitting fully idle. Want that?
